metadata.title: Technical Support
metadata.description: A web application for submitting, tracking and resolving technical support requests.

home.title: Technical Support
home.subtitle: Report a problem, track its status and get an answer from the support team in one place.

create.title: Submit a request
create.description: Describe the problem and choose a category and priority.

track.title: Real-time tracking
track.description: Get notified as soon as the status changes or a reply arrives.

resolve.title: Fast resolution
resolve.description: The support team takes the request, talks to you and resolves it.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to report a problem and track your requests.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Create an account to report a problem to the support team.
register.successText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.successText: If an account with {email} exists, we sent a link to set a new password. Check your inbox.

reset.title: New password
reset.description: Enter a new password for your account.

auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.

validation.fullNameLength: Name must be between 2 and 100 characters.
validation.passwordWeak: Password must have at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password can have at most 72 characters.
validation.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the old one.
validation.titleLength: The title must be 5 to 150 characters long.
validation.descriptionLength: The description must be 10 to 5000 characters long.
validation.commentLength: The comment must be 1 to 5000 characters long.
validation.scoreRange: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
validation.ratingCommentLength: The rating comment can be at most 1000 characters long.
validation.rangeOrder: The “from” date cannot be after the “to” date.
validation.rangeTooLong: The period can be at most 366 days long.
validation.slugFormat: The slug may contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 60 characters).
validation.categoryNameLength: The name must be 2 to 60 characters long.
validation.categoryDescriptionLength: The description may be at most 300 characters long.
validation.sortOrderRange: The order must be a whole number from 0 to 1000.

profile.title: My profile
profile.passwordDescription: After the change, sign in with your new password.
profile.googleAccount: You sign in with Google, so this account has no password in the app.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.descriptionCustomer: Overview of your tickets and what is waiting for you.
dashboard.descriptionAgent: Your work queue: assigned, unassigned and urgent tickets.
dashboard.descriptionAdmin: State of all tickets and the support team's workload.
dashboard.waitingOnMeEmpty: No tickets are waiting for your reply.
dashboard.toRateEmpty: No resolved tickets are waiting for a rating.
dashboard.recentEmpty: You have not submitted any tickets yet.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Changes to your tickets and the team's tickets, newest first.
notifications.markedAllRead: All notifications are marked as read.

types.internal_comment_added: {actor} added an internal note to ticket #{number}

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: This page is available to administrators only.
forbidden.customerOnly: New tickets are submitted by customers. As a support team member, you handle tickets on the “Tickets” page.

list.descriptionCustomer: Tickets you have submitted and their current status.
list.descriptionStaff: All customer tickets. Filter, search and pick up a ticket to work on.
list.emptyCustomer: You have not submitted any tickets yet.
list.caption: Ticket list

new.title: New ticket
new.description: Describe the problem as precisely as you can. The support team will reply in this ticket.
new.titleHint: Short, e.g. “Printer in office 12 is not working”.
new.descriptionHint: What happened, when, and what you have already tried.

detail.creator: Requester
detail.notFoundText: The ticket does not exist or you do not have access to it.

actions.title: Actions
actions.none: There are no actions you can take right now.
actions.resolvedHint: The support team marked this ticket as resolved. Confirm the resolution, or reopen it if the problem persists.
actions.cancelConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel this ticket? After that, only the support team can reopen it.

comments.title: Comments
comments.internalHint: Visible to the support team only, not to the customer.
comments.label: New comment
comments.closed: The ticket is closed, so it can no longer be commented on.

rating.title: Satisfaction rating
rating.prompt: How satisfied are you with the resolution?

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The data is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.AUTH_CALLBACK_FAILED: Sign-in failed or the link has expired. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account has been deactivated. Contact an administrator.
errors.NOT_ASSIGNED_AGENT: This ticket is not assigned to you.
errors.FORBIDDEN_INTERNAL_COMMENT: Only support team members can write internal notes.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Check your inbox.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item does not exist.
errors.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: The ticket does not exist or you do not have access to it.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed.
errors.TICKET_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: The ticket has already been taken by another agent.
errors.ASSIGNEE_NOT_AGENT: A ticket can only be assigned to an active support team member.
errors.TICKET_CLOSED: The ticket is closed and cannot be changed.
errors.ALREADY_RATED: This ticket has already been rated.
errors.TICKET_NOT_RESOLVED: A ticket can be rated only after it is resolved.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: You cannot change the role or status of your own account.
errors.CATEGORY_SLUG_TAKEN: A category with this slug already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

apiDocs.title: API documentation
apiDocs.description: All application API calls (OpenAPI 3). For calls that require sign-in, click “Authorize” and enter an access token (JWT).

analytics.description: Support team performance in the selected period. Times are in the Belgrade time zone.
analytics.invalidRange: The period in the address is not valid, so the last 30 days are shown.

kpi.label: Key indicators
kpi.openHint: Does not depend on the period

dimension.title: Breakdown of new tickets
dimension.label: Breakdown view
dimension.empty: There are no new tickets in this period.

agents.title: Team performance
agents.note: Results count for the agent the ticket is currently assigned to.
agents.empty: No team members with results in this period.

csat.title: Satisfaction ratings
csat.empty: There are no ratings in this period.

users.description: All accounts: search, change roles and deactivate.
users.caption: Accounts
users.empty: No accounts match the selected filters.
users.self: This is your account. You cannot change your own role or account.
users.openTickets: {count, plural, one {# unresolved ticket} other {# unresolved tickets}}

confirm.deactivateText: {name} will not be able to sign in until you activate the account again.
confirm.openTickets: {name} has {count, plural, one {# unresolved ticket} other {# unresolved tickets}}. They will go back to the queue.

categories.description: Categories customers choose when reporting a ticket. Categories are not deleted but deactivated: existing tickets keep them.
categories.caption: Categories
categories.deactivated: Category “{name}” has been deactivated. Existing tickets keep it.

form.description: Customers see the name and description in the language they chose.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. network.
form.sortOrderHint: A lower number comes earlier in lists.
